services.name: Daily Cruise
services.desc: As the day ends and the evening begins, join the crew of the Downeast Rover and experience the natural splendor of the protected waters of Roanoke Sound. OBX was voted 5th best location in the U.S. to watch a sunset, by USA Today. So reserve your front-row seat today! Step aboard a 55-foot topsail schooner at Manteo’s waterfront and choose your departure time. Enjoy a scenic charter to the protected waters of Roanoke Sound, perfect for creating lasting memories. Our Daily Cruise is especially popular for families with children. If you are looking for that unique special occasion activity, the crew on the Downeast Rover will create it for you by providing an unforgettable sailing charter.

services.name: The Sunset Cruise
services.desc: An Outer Banks sunset is a special sight! Rates Adults, Childre, Infants and Senior/Military $60 Duration 2 hours About The OBX has been voted by USA Today as the 5th best location in the United States to watch a sunset. Join us for a leisurely sound cruise to witness a spectacular site. There is no finer place to relax and celebrate the end of a perfect day at the beach. Adults are encouraged to bring a beverage of choice to toast the end of a special day or special occasion. Ice and cups are provided! There is a limit set by the US Coast Guard of a max of 25 people for each tour. Everyone is counted in this total including children, infants and seniors. What to Bring If you like bring

services.name: Private Day Charter
services.desc: Perfect way to enjoy the outer banks and have the ship to yourself Rates Private Charter $700 Duration 2 hours About Over the last 23 years, we’ve entertained thousands of guests with our private charters on the Rover. From water-loving locals to vacationers looking for the ultimate sailing experience, nothing is quite like relaxing away the summer hours on the Downeast Rover. With gentle waves caressing the boat and sweet breezes across the sound, allow the Downeast Rover crew to take you on a memorable sailing cruise.
